scenarios.name: Launch a command moved to the expanded panel

scenario_steps.name: the full 3D Model ribbon shows Shell in the Modify main panel
the user moves Shell to the expanded panel using its context menu
the user opens the Modify expanded panel
the user selects Shell from the expanded panel
the Shell properties panel opens with a preview in the viewport
the Modify expanded panel remains visible in the captured state
the user clicks Cancel in the Shell properties panel
the properties panel and preview close
the Modify expanded panel is no longer visible
the user opens the Modify expanded panel
the user moves Shell back to the main panel using its context menu
Shell appears in the main Modify panel
